en.a: The same six M4 axes combine into very different serving paths: latent cache, sparse routing, local windows, learned sinks, or a recurrent state.
en.b: Every case remains a prefix-conditioned next-token predictor. The architectural difference is the representation and transport of the prefix, not the prediction interface.

zh.a: 相同的六个 M4 轴组合成截然不同的服务路径：潜在缓存、稀疏路由、局部窗口、学习到的 sink，或循环状态。
zh.b: 每个案例仍然是前缀条件化的下一个 token 预测器。架构差异在于前缀的表示和传输，而非预测接口。
